name: Rossell Techsys Limited
summary: Rossell Techsys Limited provides engineering and manufacturing solutions for the global aerospace and defense industry in India and internationally. The company provides electrical wiring interconnection system (EWIS) services to rotary and fixed wing military platforms, commercial platforms, weapon systems, avionics, land systems, and marine and space systems, as well as EWIS installation services. It also offers custom electronics assemblies, including hardware, software, firmware, systems engineering, and others for data acquisition and control, power management, signal conditioning interfaces and high-fidelity processing, instrumentation, control systems, communication systems, avionics …
